verdict.rationale: NVIDIA Isaac is a robotics simulation and learning platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack mentions agent skills for Isaac Lab and Isaac ROS, but these are a different feature and are not an MCP server. Nothing in the evidence shows an official MCP server or endpoint, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
